description.value:
You launch up to four wires at creatures you choose within 30 feet; a single creature can be targeted by more than one wire. Each target makes a Dexterity saving throw for every wire aimed at it, becoming restrained and falling prone on a failure as the wire binds it securely.

A creature restrained by a wire can use its action to make a Strength or Dexterity check (its choice) against your tech save DC, freeing itself from that wire on a success. A wire can instead be destroyed; each has AC 15, 10 hit points, and immunity to all damage except from melee weapons. Any wire that misses or is escaped goes slack and disintegrates, as do all remaining wires when the power ends.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 4
